# Targeted native receiving completion

Current work adds a receiving-only native wallet, separate from Counterpart and Pollar. See [service boundary](../../services/zcash-receiving/README.md).

**REAL preflight:** [native-preflight.json](live/native-preflight.json) is an authenticated response from the durable Railway wallet, generated by `zaw`/librustzcash. Its Unified address is wallet-controlled, not user-entered. It is unpaid and contains no receipt evidence. The wallet is synced to public Zcash Testnet, supports NU7 and runs locked. `/status` rejects unauthenticated access and `/api/owner/login` is not forwarded even with the backend credential.

**TESTED WITH MOCKS:** [fixture-browser](fixture-browser/results.json) uses ephemeral application records and mocked sponsor transport, including synthetic confirmation screenshots. It proves browser/API/state handling, not live settlement. Focused tests:115 passed. Full suite:1,637 passed,47 skipped. Production build, typecheck and lint passed. Desktop/mobile browser regressions passed at1440,820,390,320 pixels.

The service's first native starts were SIGKILLed by the Railway1GiB ceiling. A pinned source build now limits seed-at-rest scrypt memory to256MiB, using a384-bit random secret. This does not change wallet generation, receiving trial decryption, signing, scanning or consensus code. No signer is unlocked or exposed.

The original synthetic TypeScript sender remains unused. Public chain data, faucet API success and wallet balance alone cannot settle an invoice. Only the invoice-bound receiving wallet's decrypted exact-value note and confirmations can do so. Live application/funding acceptance will be recorded separately; this preflight is not claimed as an end-to-end payment.
